name: Sweet Emotion
original_name: スウィートエモーション
source:
There are five scenarios presented from different viewpoints and connected with each other. Together they let us approach the truth about Slan murder.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/05/vn-of-month-july-1991.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
五篇故事分别从不同人物的视角展开，彼此又紧密相连。将它们拼在一起，便能逐步接近斯兰·戴维斯遇害案的真相。

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/05/vn-of-month-july-1991.html]vndbreview[/url]]
